name: multiclient
description: A local-first desktop client for your AI tools
author: Multiclient contributors

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && electron-vite build && node scripts/build-artifact-renderer.cjs && node scripts/build-supervisor.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/test-storage.cjs && node scripts/test-history.cjs && node scripts/test-features.cjs && node scripts/test-comparison.cjs && node scripts/test-artifacts.cjs && node scripts/test-web-worker.cjs && playwright test
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts *.ts *.json *.yml docs .cursor/skills/verify-multiclient AGENTS.md BACKLOG.md README.md SECURITY.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts *.ts *.json *.yml docs .cursor/skills/verify-multiclient AGENTS.md BACKLOG.md README.md SECURITY.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
